steps.title: Unit 3 Test
steps.html:
Всё из трёх уроков этого юнита.

  • Урок 7: So… what do you do?
  • Урок 8: My place (no filter)
  • Урок 9: What's in your bag?

steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Выберите правильный ответ.
steps.html:
Nurlan

Hi! I'm Nurlan. I'm a taxi driver.

I work in Almaty. My car is old but it's good.

My wife is a nurse. She works in a hospital.

Our daughter is a student. She studies English.

steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Дополните предложение.

steps.html:
Sam

Hi! I'm Sam. I live in a small flat in Almaty.

There's one bedroom and a big kitchen.

There isn't a garden, but there's a balcony.

The lift is next to the exit, on the left.

steps.title: Расставьте слова по порядку.
steps.answer: The lift is on the left.

steps.title: Найдите ошибку.
steps.answer: I live in a small flat.

steps.title: Послушайте. Выберите правильный ответ.
options: No, and there isn't a shower.

steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Дополните предложение.
steps.html:
Dina

Hi! I'm Dina. This is my bag.

I've got a laptop, two pens and a small umbrella.

I haven't got a car, but I've got a bicycle.

My sister's bag is bigger. She's got a map of the city.

steps.title: Расставьте слова по порядку.
steps.answer: She has not got a car.

steps.title: Тест по юниту пройден
